data.body: Ticket 6's change 2462 got LLM-Review-1 with 1 blocking + 4 advisory findings, all legitimate: (1) docs/llm-framework.md's documented review_code() usage example unconditionally read f["severity"], now updated to derive a label from decision when present; (2) docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md documented BLOCKING_SEVERITIES as a live operator-tunable env var, now corrected; (3) test_pass3_decide_never_stamps_a_severity_key only covered 3 of 5 return sites, strengthened to also cover the low-validity-drop and cited-reference-veto sites; (4) docs/adr/0077 line 55 said blocking_severities "may be removed" as a future follow-on, updated to note it's now done. Fixed all 5, confirmed 476 targeted tests + the actual gated lint set (src tests scripts, NOT docs/ which isn't part of `make lint`'s $(sources)) both clean, amended commit 005ecbb, re-pushed patchset 2 to https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2462.
